description: Frozen matched MAP comparison; not original-paper replication
source_citation: Lewis, Jeffrey B., Keith Poole, Howard Rosenthal, Adam Boche, Aaron Rudkin, and Luke Sonnet (2026). Voteview: Congressional Roll-Call Votes Database. https://voteview.com/

preprocessing.roll_filter_outcomes: training outcomes only; held-out Yea/Nay unused
preprocessing.party_labels: display and orientation only; not used in estimation

split.rule: independent uniform draw on sorted member-by-roll grid before training-only roll filtering

model.prior_warning: Identical parameter priors do not induce identical probability priors across q.
model.q1_numerics: exact Euclidean norm; no smoothing; zero vector chosen as subgradient at exact coincidence

optimization_plan.selection: lowest training penalized negative log likelihood only
optimization_plan.initialization: start 0 training-residual SVD, start 1 perturbed SVD, remaining starts independent Gaussian coordinates; shared seed and coordinates across q

interpretation: One data set and one common split; descriptive comparison only, no significance or general superiority claim.

sensitivity_plan.starts_at_each_other_sd: selected s=1 fit plus shared random-coordinate start 2
sensitivity_plan.selection: lowest training penalized objective at each scale; all three scales reported; no holdout-based selection
sensitivity_plan.freeze_note: Added before running any model fit; processed data and mask unchanged.
